recognize_zh: 中央單一淋巴球，細胞比小淋巴球大、細胞質豐富淡藍色，內含散在的紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），核圓略偏心、染色質凝集，即大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Medium-to-large lymphocyte with low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered fine-to-coarse azurophilic granules
Round to slightly oval, eccentric nucleus with condensed chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Background normocytic normochromic RBCs and normal platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large granular lymphocyte with a round, slightly eccentric nucleus with condensed chromatin, no visible nucleolus, and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered azurophilic granules. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and platelets appear normal. The cell is a morphologically typical large granular lymphocyte; a sustained LGL count above 2 x 10^9/L with clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement and STAT3 mutation would support T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive (Downey) lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that scallops around RBCs with peripheral basophilia and typically lack prominent azurophilic granules.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia cells are larger and more atypical with open chromatin and nucleoli, and are EBV-positive.
Myeloid precursors have more numerous, dense granules and a larger nucleus with finer chromatin or a Golgi hof.
Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like projections and lack azurophilic granules.
